ThreadInteractiveSubscriptionEntry.description:
A server-owned count of trusted interactive clients attached to one exact thread.

This is subscription evidence only. It does not establish thread succession, loaded state, or authority to transfer a clear transition.

interactiveSubscriptionCount.description: Distinct live thread-event subscriptions held by server-verified interactive clients. Not evidence of human presence, focus or retention.

description: An atomic subscription-state transition. A zero count explicitly records a removal; it is not encoded by omitting an entry.
title: ThreadInteractiveSubscriptionChangedNotification
